title: Migration Plan
description: Output schema for plan.json produced by the plan-migration skill.

feature_name.description: Short identifier for the feature being migrated.

description.description: One to two sentence description of the migration.

knowledge_level.description: User's self-assessed familiarity with the codebase.

migration_type.description: Type of migration: language-change, framework-upgrade, architecture-change, cloud-migration, or user-defined.

source_stack.description: Current technology stack being migrated from.

languages.description: Programming languages in the source system.

frameworks.description: Frameworks and libraries in the source system.

test_command.description: Shell command to run the source project's test suite. Null if unknown.

test_framework.description: Test framework used (e.g., 'JUnit 5', 'pytest', 'Jest'). Null if unknown.

test_directory.description: Root test source directory (e.g., 'src/test/java', 'tests'). Null if unknown.

target_stack.description: Target technology stack being migrated to.

languages.description: Programming languages for the target system.

frameworks.description: Frameworks and libraries for the target system.

infrastructure.description: Infrastructure components for the target system.

scope.description: What is included and excluded from the migration.

exclude.description: Components, modules, or areas explicitly out of scope.

critical_components.description: High-risk or high-importance components requiring extra attention.

internal.description: Other modules or shared libraries this feature depends on.

external.description: External APIs, services, or databases this feature depends on.

mitigation.description: How to mitigate this risk, if known.

success_criteria.description: Concrete, verifiable criteria that define migration completion.

focus_areas.description: Priority areas ranked by importance, guiding downstream analysis and architecture.

modules.description: Modules involved in the migration. Links back to index.json modules when available, but also captures user-identified modules not in the documentation.

name.description: Module name. Should match modules[].name from index.json when sourced from documentation.

source.description: Whether this module was identified from index.json or provided by the user during the interview.

doc_file.description: Path to module documentation from index.json (e.g. modules/order-service.md), if available.

role.description: Role in the migration: primary (being migrated), dependency (used by primary modules), affected (impacted but not directly migrated).

notes.description: User-provided context about this module's relevance to the migration.
Open-ended notes, context, or observations from the interview that don't fit into the structured fields above.
